summary: The Corporate Energy Buyers Association answers in support of the SPP Joint Movants' amended motion for a 95-day abeyance in EL26-68 and asks FERC to grant it on an expedited basis.
ask: Grant the Joint Movants' amended motion for a 95-day abeyance in an expedited manner.

points.point: CEBA says abeyance lets SPP and stakeholders work collaboratively instead of moving the debate to the FERC docket.
points.quote: as opposed to a rushed proposal that would unnecessarily shift stakeholder debate to the Commission docket.

points.point: CEBA says the abeyance accommodates the Regional State Committee and SPP Board meetings.
points.quote: reasonable accommodations necessary to convene the Regional State Committee and the SPP Board of Directors

points.point: CEBA says the 95 days would not materially slow reform and would improve commercial viability and legal durability.
points.quote: extension would not materially impede the Commission's objectives for advancing reforms quickly yet offers significant benefits

throughLine.text: A buyer-side answer supporting the E-9 SPP abeyance motion, which moved the 60-day show cause response to November 20, 2026.

figures.label: Abeyance requested for SPP show cause proceeding
figures.quote: Joint Movants ask the Commission to hold this proceeding in abeyance by 95 days
